title: Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29{\sigma} arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score
abstract: arXiv:2610.00234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. translated_title: 冲突监督改变的是承诺而非能力：在约定无关评分下恰好为零的12.29σ排列效应
translated_abstract: 在用两种互不兼容的约定（两种都正确）书写的相同问题上训练一个模型，然后探究这种数据的排列顺序在参数中写入了什么。学习率调度并不是该问题的背景条件，它本身就是平均算子，并由它决定答案。我们证明了一个界，其中排列和调度作为相互独立的乘积因子进入排序效应：排列仅以块周期的形式出现，调度仅以终点能赋予训练运行中任一时刻多大权重的方式出现。衰减调度无法在同一时刻同时产生大步长和未收缩的余项；而恒定调度恰恰在最后一步做到了这一点。衰减能缓和排序效应在预训练中已有报道；但其机制、这种分离结构以及对两个部分的受控测量是我们的贡献。对单一语料库的十种排序、单一预算，除路径外一切条件固定，在两族设置下各运行两次……
tldr: 该论文证明学习率调度是决定训练数据排序效应的平均算子，排列与调度以独立乘积因子形式进入该效应，衰减调度可消除恒定调度在最后一步产生的12.29σ排序效应，且该效应在约定无关评分下恰好为零，表明冲突监督改变的是模型的“承诺”而非“能力”。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that the learning-rate schedule is the averaging operator determining data-ordering effects, with arrangement and schedule entering as separate multiplicative factors, so that decaying schedules erase the 12.29σ ordering effect that constant schedules create at the last step—an effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score, showing conflicting supervision moves commitment, not capability.
